human_assistance.detail: Muse requested an extra direct-owner task confirmation. User actually clicked 执行本轮静置验收 at16:34. No claim of autonomous confirmation; this was a Muse task-rule interaction, not a phone system authentication or tool-enforced identity step.

evidence_classification.RECEIPTS.md: Muse-produced redacted command-result excerpts, not complete raw status/wait-ready/observe/home JSON. Full device identifiers and those raw files were intentionally not included.
evidence_classification.screenshots: Two actual phone screenshots opened and visually inspected by release maintainer: calculator1104 and reopened synthetic note. No desktop or note-list images included.
evidence_classification.feedback_JSON: Five Muse-exported synthetic-report request/response JSON copies; verified consistent ID and POST201/GET200/DELETE200/GET410. This feedback ran before idle, not a new post-idle feedback submission.
evidence_classification.independent_phone_check: Read-only installed APK hash/package, power/service/process diagnostics after Muse task; no maintainer device actions performed task.
evidence_classification.independent_report_check: Release maintainer queried only the known synthetic report through report-admin API after retrieval; HTTP410 confirmed on2026-10-26.

independent_phone_check.performed_after: Muse UI reported final HOME and stopped; no maintenance ADB requests issued during quiet window or Muse execution
independent_phone_check.actions: read package/version, pull installed APK, read power/service/process and Airtap diagnostic tag only; no input/UI/screenshot/network changes

limits: USB remained physically connected and powered; this is not an unplugged or mobile-only test.
One approximately75-minute sample does not establish overnight or multi-day reliability.
Initial setup and extra task confirmation had human involvement; not an independent novice or unattended setup proof.
No exact per-key timestamps or full original device command JSON in shared evidence.
Earlier Muse/Instinct code24 acceptance is separate; this result does not validate Instinct on beta4 or other devices.
